metric_definition.AAA_sample: Equal mean of all ten global stage top1 values

metric_definition.AAA_task: Equal mean of per-stage equal task means
metric_definition.rounding: Computed from rounded source log values

notes: FS-EWC is a display alias for GAM-EWC+Merge/GAM-EWC+A lineage, not an independent extra method.
